questions.question:
What should come in place of the ‘?’ in the given series?

6 15 29 54 84 125 ?
questions.solution:
**The logic followed here is:**

 

 
• 6 **+ 9 = 15**
 
• 15 **+ 14 = 29**
 
• 29 **+ 25 = 54**
 
• 54 **+ 30 = 84**
 
• 84 **+ 41 = 125**
 
• 125 **+ 46 = 171**

 
 
 
 

Thus, the missing term in the series is **171**.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**;

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusions logically follow/s from the given statements.

Statements: All vans are trailers. No trailer is a scooter.

Conclusion (I) : No van is a scooter

Conclusion (II) : Some scooters are trailers
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa3ed2bdd23e73e2357de8bd2a9e2199f087874b069e8ed8da94bf3932db7033.png] 

**(I) No van is a scooter - Follows**

(There is no direct relation between a van and a scooter; hence, it is true).

**(II) Some scooters are trailers - Doesn't follow**

(There is no direct relation established between scooters and trailers; maybe it is possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

Only conclusion (I) follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is " Option 2"**
